Self-authored synthetic fixture. No external assets, game data or fonts.
Created with FFmpeg from color and sine source filters:
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i 'color=c=red:s=32x32:r=25:d=0.32' -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=48000:duration=0.32' -c:v mpeg2video -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a mp2 -b:a 128k -ac 2 -shortest -f mpeg media_av.mpg
